Code 
# Extract the embeddings matrix
mat <- do.call(cbind, embeddings$texts)

# Remove rows with missing values (to avoid UMAP errors)
keep_idx <- complete.cases(mat)
mat_clean <- mat[keep_idx, ]
texts_clean <- texts[keep_idx]

# UMAP dimensionality reduction (2D for visualization)
umap_embeddings <- umap(mat_clean, n_neighbors = 15, n_components = 2)

# HDBSCAN clustering
cl <- hdbscan(umap_embeddings, minPts = 12)

# Combine into dataframe
df_plot <- data.frame(
  text = texts_clean,
  x = umap_embeddings[,1],
  y = umap_embeddings[,2],
  cluster = factor(cl$cluster)
)

# Plot with labels
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x, y, color = cluster, label = text)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 30) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cognitive Paradigm Clusters (Semantic Embeddings + UMAP + HDBSCAN)")
